source: For ordinary ZXNAME0000XZ,ZXMATH0000XZ ZXMATH0001XZ In ZXNAME0001XZ,ZXMATH0002XZ = 1. In ZXNAME0002XZ, ZXMATH0003XZ Current Dao-AILab kernels support ZXNAME0003XZ/ZXNAME0004XZ by passing fewer KV heads than query heads, with the requirement that the number of query heads be divisible by the number of KV heads.[8]
zh: 对于普通的 ZXNAME0000XZ,ZXMATH0000XZ ZXMATH0001XZ 在 ZXNAME0001XZ,ZXMATH0002XZ = 1 中。在 ZXNAME0002XZ,ZXMATH0003XZ 中，当前 Dao-AILab 内核通过传递比查询头更少的 KV 头来支持 ZXNAME0003XZ/ZXNAME0004XZ，要求查询头的数量可以被KV头的数量整除。[8]
